name: skill-suggester
description: Skill recommendation for AI agents from the agent-skills library. Reads the master catalog index.json (default ~/Projects/agent-skills/index.json, override with env AGENT_SKILLS_INDEX or --index), scores triggers and descriptions, returns top-5 with relevance plus up to 3 combos (chains) for multi-step tasks. Supports ad-hoc apply: prints SKILL.md paths so the agent can read and apply a skill's instructions directly even if it is not installed. Triggers: 'какой скилл использовать', 'подбор скилла', 'подобрать скилл', 'skill suggestion', 'suggest skill', 'рекомендовать скилл', 'recommend a skill', 'which skill', 'подобрать навык', 'какой skill использовать'.
author: bestdeejay-design
